items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: it was on the set with Joe Jones, on drums, Illinois Jackson, me and Buddy Tate

ctx.x: '67. I was working the Cafe Animal and my boss gave me the Sunday (phonetic) and I went to Austin, and it was on the set with Joe Jones, on drums, Illinois Jackson, me and Buddy Tate -- three Texas tenors.

And I put my best foot forward. You know why? Because of the thing we talked about prior to New York before I moved back to Texas and it never materialized -- I said, "I'm gonna show you how this thing could really go." That was what I was saying to myself, now. And ... I can lay down and be lazy, I could get up and play -- but you know, there ain't nobody that great. So you got to let people know.
